text: 说个好笑的。
en: Here's a funny one.

text: 以前的杀手锏是：支持合法，你希望你老婆女儿去卖吗？
en: The old trump card was this: support legalisation — do you want your wife and daughters to go and sell themselves?

text: 现在的结婚率，这招已经不好用了。
en: With today's marriage rate, this trick no longer works.

text: 我当笑话讲，大家当笑话听。
en: I tell it as a joke, and everyone listens as a joke.

text: 有人说，如果卖淫合法，那么你的老婆孩子就会去卖淫。
en: Some say that if prostitution were legal, then your wife and children would go into prostitution.

text: 这句话的逻辑往前推一下，会看到一个很搞笑的事情。
en: Push the logic of that statement a little further and you'll see something quite ridiculous.

text: 那就是说，他的老婆孩子之所以现在没有去卖淫，只是单纯因为卖淫不合法。
en: That is to say, the only reason his wife and children aren't in prostitution right now is simply that prostitution is illegal.

text: 因为卖淫一合法，他老婆孩子接着就去卖淫了。
en: Because the moment prostitution becomes legal, his wife and children would promptly go into prostitution.

text: 说句实话，卖淫这个事情部分是合法的，部分是不合法的。
en: To be honest, prostitution is partly legal and partly illegal.

text: 针对权贵，卖淫就是合法的。
en: For the powerful and privileged, prostitution is legal.

text: 他们包养情人，一个出卖肉体，一个给钱给物，不是卖淫是什么？
en: They keep mistresses — one sells the body, the other gives money and goods. What is that if not prostitution?

text: 但是法律是不管的。
en: But the law does not intervene.

text: 对于平头百姓，卖淫就是非法的。
en: For ordinary folk, prostitution is illegal.

text: 评论区太多人主体性过剩了，一张嘴就是“你老婆你老妈你女儿”只把女性当附庸是吧，
en: Far too many people in the comments have an overinflated sense of self — the moment they open their mouths it's 'your wife, your mother, your daughter', treating women merely as appendages, is that it?

text: 我的回答是，一人一个脑子，自己做决策自己承担责任，别人怎么样我都管不到(作为监护人角色除外)，我只能管好我自己。
en: My answer is: everyone has their own mind, makes their own decisions and bears their own responsibility. I cannot control what others do (except in my role as a guardian); I can only manage myself.

text: 我问你一个问题，我看日本的A片，伤害了哪个中国人？
en: Let me ask you a question: when I watch Japanese porn, which Chinese person have I harmed?

text: 既然没有伤害中国人，那为何中国的法律有资格管我？
en: Since no Chinese person has been harmed, why does Chinese law have any right to govern me?

text: 如果要管我，那也该是东京hot来在日本进行起诉，一旦我获得日本上陆许可就把我绳之以法。
en: If anyone is to govern me, it ought to be Tokyo Hot, prosecuting me in Japan; the moment I obtain a landing permit for Japan, they can bring me to justice.

text: 说个真事，
en: Here is a true story,

text: 一个23岁的德国女性失业了，领失业金。
en: A 23-year-old German woman lost her job and began claiming unemployment benefit.

text: 三个月后失业金停发，原因是政府给介绍了三份工作她都拒绝了。
en: Three months later her benefit was stopped, because the government had found her three jobs, all of which she refused.

text: 看起来很合理吧，
en: Seems perfectly reasonable, does it not,

text: 可问题是三份工作都是妓女。
en: But the problem is that all three jobs were as a prostitute.

text: 现实版的逼良为娼！
en: A real-life case of forcing the virtuous into prostitution!

text: 以武汉为例：
en: Take Wuhan as an example:

text: 7个中心城区，每个区20家做92的。
en: Seven central districts, each with twenty establishments doing '92'.

text: 每家平均8个老师。
en: Each establishment averages eight teachers.

text: 那就是160个。
en: That makes one hundred and sixty.

text: 武汉市算1600个在职老师不算多吧。
en: Wuhan having one thousand six hundred working teachers is not too many, is it?

text: 湖北省算他16000不算多吧。
en: Hubei Province — call it sixteen thousand, not too many, is it?

text: 湖北省算中位的。
en: Hubei is about median.

text: 不算多也不算少。
en: Neither too many nor too few.
Nationwide: 16,000 × 30 = 480,000 people.

text: 算50万在职的吧。
en: Call it five hundred thousand working ones.

text: 这些在职的老师平均工龄5年吧。
en: These working teachers have an average tenure of five years, let us say.

text: 近20年从事过92工作的20-40岁的女的差不多有200万人不过分吧。
en: Over the past nearly twenty years, women aged twenty to forty who have done '92' work — about two million is not unreasonable.

text: 实际上，还有大量从事擦边的，尽管不做92，但是也是见不得人的那种擦边的，这种甚至比92的还多得多。
en: In reality, there are also great numbers engaged in borderline work — though not '92', it is that shameful kind of borderline activity, and there are even far more of these than of the '92' workers.

text: 我感觉，我这算法觉得算少了，实际上从事过92工作的要翻个三四倍。
en: I feel my calculation is an underestimate; in reality those who have done '92' work would be three or four times higher.

text: 近乎千万成年女性从事过92工作。
en: Nearly ten million adult women have done '92' work.

text: 真不过分。
en: Truly not an overstatement.

text: 美团上的一艘一大把。
en: On Meituan there are a great many of them.

text: 我在推上经常能收到这样的私信，大部分都是大学生，我也和几个门姐聊过天，基本上都是家里条件不好没办法给生活费所以自己在推上挣
en: On Twitter I often receive private messages like this; most are university students. I have also chatted with a few menjie, and basically they all come from families too poor to give them living expenses, so they earn it themselves on Twitter.

text: 很多都是之前不接线下的，现在线下可以接了，价格也不贵，有个门姐5200甚至能一个月。
en: Many of them did not take offline clients before, but now can take them, and the price is not high — there was a menjie who could even make five thousand two hundred in a month.

text: B站擦边的也越来越多，有句话说的挺好的，孔乙己不是不脱长衫，她们甚至把裤衩子都脱了，错的是她们吗？
en: On Bilibili, borderline content is also growing. There is a saying that puts it well: it is not that Kong Yiji would not take off his long gown — they have even taken off their underpants. Are they the ones in the wrong?

text: 最后我说一句我的观点，人和人的价值观是不同的，如何选择是个人行为，己所甚欲亦勿施于人
en: Finally, let me state my view: people's values differ; how one chooses is a personal matter. Do not impose upon others even what you yourself greatly desire.

text: 看了很多回答，为什么有人一边支持彩礼一边反对卖银，或者一边支持彩礼一边反对代运。
en: Having read many answers, why is it that some people support bride prices while opposing prostitution, or support bride prices while opposing surrogacy?

text: 我很难理解啊。
en: I find it very hard to understand.

text: 比起这个问题本身，这个问题下面的答主才更有意思
en: Compared with the question itself, the answerers beneath it are far more interesting.

text: 这问题下的女答主，不说全部，但大部分在反对卖淫合法的基础上，同时也会支持彩礼，因为她们认为女方在婚姻中付出了性，所以男方必须用各种方式支付包括性在内的“女方提供的服务”
en: The female answerers under this question — not all, but most — while opposing the legalisation of prostitution, also support bride prices, because they believe the woman contributes sex within marriage, so the man must pay in various ways for the 'services the woman provides', including sex.

text: 这种左右脑互搏就是单纯因为这些女答主双标
en: This kind of self-contradiction is simply because these female answerers are being hypocritical.

text: 再来讲这个问题下很多回答的常见的逻辑错误
en: Next, let me address the common logical errors in many of the answers under this question.

text: 要么把赞成者打为嫖娼者，也就是人身攻击
en: Either label the supporters as clients of prostitutes — that is, a personal attack —

text: 要么声称“如果你支持卖淫合法，那你也就支持你的家人卖淫”
en: Or claim, 'If you support legalising prostitution, then you also support your family members engaging in prostitution.'

text: 这句话用了概念偷换，把“支持某事的法律立场”偷换成了“支持某事发生”，甚至直接偷换成“支持特定对象发生某事”
en: This sentence uses a conceptual substitution, replacing 'supporting a legal stance on something' with 'supporting something happening', or even directly substituting it with 'supporting a specific person doing something'.

text: 我用最简单的例子就能让大家明白“如果你支持杀人偿命，那你也就支持你的家人杀人”
en: I can use the simplest example to make everyone understand: 'If you support the death penalty for murder, then you also support your family members committing murder.'

text: 权利和行使权利是两码事
en: A right and the exercise of a right are two different matters.

text: 支持离婚合法，不等于支持家人离婚；支持饮酒合法，不等于支持家人喝酒；支持持枪合法，不等于支持家人持枪
en: Supporting the legality of divorce does not mean supporting your family's divorce; supporting the legality of drinking does not mean supporting your family's drinking; supporting the legality of gun ownership does not mean supporting your family's gun ownership.

text: 而且“支持卖淫合法就是支持家人卖淫”这句话不是论证“卖淫合法化有什么坏处”，而是用“你家人”来让你难堪、厌恶、闭嘴。
en: Moreover, the statement 'supporting prostitution legalisation means supporting your family's prostitution' is not an argument about 'what harms legalising prostitution would bring'; it uses 'your family' to make you feel ashamed, disgusted, and shut up.

text: 逻辑上，这叫稻草人谬误加诉诸情感/人身攻击：先把对方立场极端化为“鼓励家人卖淫”，再用亲情压力代替论证。
en: Logically, this is the straw-man fallacy combined with an appeal to emotion / personal attack: first extremise the opponent's position into 'encouraging family members to prostitute themselves', then use family pressure in place of argument.

text: 反驳卖淫得拿出论证，应该讨论合法化是否导致剥削、人口贩卖、监管困难等实际问题
en: To refute prostitution one must produce arguments — we should discuss whether legalisation leads to exploitation, human trafficking, regulatory difficulty and other practical problems.

text: 影视飓风刚出的采访孟加拉性工作者视频。
en: Media Storm has just released a video interviewing sex workers in Bangladesh.

text: 视频团队前往孟加拉国的Daulatdia（达乌拉特迪亚），这是世界上规模最大的性产业聚集区之一，常住性工作者超过千人。
en: The video team travelled to Daulatdia, Bangladesh, one of the world's largest sex-industry clusters, with a permanent population of over a thousand sex workers.

text: 下面为了方便介绍我称之为红灯区。
en: Below, for convenience, I will refer to it as the red-light district.

text: 在孟加拉，性工作者是合法的，只要年满18岁，因为贫困出于自愿。
en: In Bangladesh, sex work is legal, so long as one is over eighteen and does it voluntarily out of poverty.

text: 记住这三条，年满18岁，贫困，自愿。
en: Remember these three conditions: over eighteen, poverty, voluntary.

text: 下面是视频中的出境受访者
en: Below are the on-camera interviewees in the video.

text: Kohenur在丈夫死后成为了寡妇，经常被村子里的人骚然，后来被带到了红灯区，30岁的她现在一子一女，女儿12岁，为了防止女儿学坏，她早早让女儿结了婚。
en: Kohenur became a widow after her husband's death, was often harassed by people in the village, and was later brought to the red-light district. Now thirty, she has a son and a daughter; her daughter is twelve. To stop her daughter going astray, she married her off early.

text: 现在的她，有一个2岁的外孙。
en: Now she has a two-year-old grandson.

text: 我并不想去深究12减2等于几…
en: I do not want to dwell on what twelve minus two equals…

text: 她的工作从12点到5点，有时候客人10到12个，有时候一个也没有。
en: Her work runs from twelve to five; sometimes she has ten to twelve clients, sometimes none at all.

text: 她的客人年龄上到五十岁，下到…
en: Her clients range in age up to fifty, down to…

text: 不知道是翻译问题还是理解问题。
en: I do not know whether it is a translation problem or a comprehension problem.

text: 当翻译问:来的客人都是做什么的？
en: When the interpreter asked: what do the clients who come do for a living?

text: Kohenur答:
en: Kohenur answered:

text: 翻译问:工作的时候有遇到不好的事吗？
en: Interpreter asked: have you encountered anything bad while working?

text: Kohenur答:
en: Kohenur answered:

text: 随后她又开了个玩笑
en: Then she cracked a joke.

text: 翻译问:为什么不去其他地方呢？
en: Interpreter asked: why not go somewhere else?

text: Kohenur表示她即使去了更好的地方也没什么可做的，男人都是只要身体，目前这份工作相对来说还算好的。
en: Kohenur said that even if she went somewhere better there would be nothing for her to do; men only want the body, and this job is relatively decent by comparison.

text: 我现在要好好养活子女们，努力满足我的孩子们。
en: Right now I must properly provide for my children and strive to satisfy my kids.

text: 满足了孩子们后
en: After satisfying the children,

text: 在视频中还参观了Kohenur的房子，房子被她打理收拾的井井有条，Kohenur的房子和她的眼睛一样，有光。
en: The video also showed a visit to Kohenur's house, which she keeps tidy and well ordered; Kohenur's house, like her eyes, has light.

text: 这期节目的制作人同样是位女性，一位新中国的女性。
en: The producer of this episode is also a woman — a woman of New China.

text: 在视频中Kohenur邀请制作人穿上了自己的衣服，孟加拉传统服饰（纱丽），二人一起翩翩起舞。
en: In the video, Kohenur invited the producer to put on her own clothes — traditional Bangladeshi dress (the sari) — and the two danced gracefully together.

text: 这是这个视频中最让我感动的一幕
en: This is the most moving scene in the whole video for me.

text: 像Kohenur这样的还算幸运，毕竟她属于红灯区相对有自主权的“独立型”工作者。
en: Someone like Kohenur is relatively fortunate; after all, she belongs to the relatively autonomous 'independent' type of worker in the red-light district.

text: 属于自己租房，自负盈亏的。
en: She rents her own place and bears her own profits and losses.

text: 收入的绝大多数可以归为自己。
en: The vast majority of her earnings can go to herself.

text: 而还有一类，属于“债务型性工作者”他们通常是被人贩子或者家人卖到这里来的，老鸨付给人贩子或家人的这笔钱就成了这些被卖掉的女孩的债务。
en: Then there is another type, the 'debt-bonded sex worker' — they are usually sold here by traffickers or family members, and the money the madam pays the trafficker or family becomes the debt of these sold girls.

text: 而要还清这笔债务，是遥遥无期的。
en: And repaying this debt is a distant, endless prospect.

text: Farida就是这样一位受害者，那时她才上五年级，被人骗到这里卖给了老鸨，十一岁的身体根本没有发育，还无法接客，而老鸨的应对方式
en: Farida is such a victim. She was only in fifth grade then, tricked and sold here to the madam. Her eleven-year-old body had not developed at all and could not yet receive clients, and the madam's response was

text: 那时的她接客价格:
en: Her client price back then:

text: 如果按次收费是一两百塔卡（约5-11元人民币）
en: If charged per session, it was one to two hundred taka (about 5–11 RMB).

text: 按小时收费则是一两千塔卡（约56-112人民币）
en: Charged by the hour, it was one to two thousand taka (about 56–112 RMB).

text: 一天的收入约为四五千塔卡（约225-282人民币）
en: Daily income was about four to five thousand taka (about 225–282 RMB).

text: 一天接客人数为二十到二十五人…
en: The number of clients per day was twenty to twenty-five…

text: 地狱的是Farida的父亲还是一名士兵，她的不幸是从父亲牺牲后开始的。
en: What is hellish is that Farida's father was a soldier, and her misfortune began after her father died in service.

text: 另一位债务型性工作者Rekha则是被自己的丈夫以10万塔卡（约5600人民币）卖到红灯区的
en: Another debt-bonded sex worker, Rekha, was sold to the red-light district by her own husband for one hundred thousand taka (about 5,600 RMB).

text: 她年纪轻轻就嫁给了之前的丈夫，她的丈夫是一个年纪很大的人，结了婚之后Rekha才知道自己丈夫已经有妻子和女儿了，甚至这个女儿都比她还要大。
en: She married her former husband when very young; her husband was a much older man. Only after marrying did Rekha learn that her husband already had a wife and a daughter — and that this daughter was even older than she was.

text: 在被丈夫卖到红灯区之前，他就已经被丈夫送到别的男人家里，甚至是兄弟家里去接客，一家接着一家的去。
en: Before being sold to the red-light district by her husband, she had already been sent by him to other men's homes, even to his brothers' homes, to receive clients, going from one family to the next.

text: 视频的第二章，展示的这个“合法”产业链条中的各个环节，按照孟加拉的法律，每一个从事性工作者的年龄都要年满十八岁，并且拥有政府颁发的执照，但是在受采访者的人当中，许多从业者都是十四五岁的，甚至还有一些年龄更小的被卖进来的女孩。
en: The video's second chapter shows the various links in this 'legal' industrial chain. Under Bangladeshi law, every sex worker must be over eighteen and hold a government-issued licence, yet among those interviewed, many practitioners were fourteen or fifteen, and some even younger girls had been sold in.

text: 她们又是怎么绕过法律的监管呢？
en: So how do they get around legal oversight?

text: 答案是老鸨会给这些年幼的女孩服用类固醇。
en: The answer is that the madams give these underage girls steroids.

text: 使他们看起来更成熟丰满。
en: To make them appear more mature and full-figured.

text: 再配合贿赂官员，伪造假的出生证明。
en: Combined with bribing officials and forging fake birth certificates.

text: 当她们来到颁发执照的官员面前时，被问为什么会从事性工作时？
en: When they stand before the officials who issue the licences and are asked why they do sex work?

text: 女孩又会被唆使撒谎，称完全是自愿行为。
en: The girls are then incited to lie, claiming it is entirely voluntary.

text: 就在这样一个走过场的形式下，官员颁发了许可证，而年幼的她们就开始了性工作者的生涯。
en: Under such a mere formality, the officials issue the licence, and these young girls begin their careers as sex workers.

text: 具体的产业链条为:皮条客或人贩子物色女孩儿，交给老鸨对其进行控制，行政机关对其颁发执照。
en: The specific industrial chain is: pimps or traffickers scout for girls, hand them to the madam who controls them, and the administrative authority issues them a licence.

text: 在这个产业链条中还有一个不可或缺的一环就是警察。
en: In this industrial chain there is also an indispensable link: the police.

text: Rekha曾经两次逃跑，都被警察抓到送回了红灯区，老鸨会支付当地警察报酬，让警察成为维持这个体系运转的一环。
en: Rekha escaped twice, but both times was caught by the police and sent back to the red-light district. The madam pays the local police, making them a link that keeps this system running.

text: 有些警察在这个链条分一杯羹的同时，还会利用手中的权利对性工作者进行免费白嫖。
en: While some police take a cut from this chain, they also use their power to take free sex from the workers.

text: 法律的制度下并没有保护本应被保护的弱势群体，反而在制度的保护下，让买卖变得合理，罪恶变得合法。
en: Under the legal system, the vulnerable groups who ought to be protected are not protected; instead, under the protection of the system, buying and selling become reasonable and evil becomes legal.

text: 和性沾边的就少不了暴力，为了免受骚扰和受到伤害，性工作者们需要去依附一个或多个“大哥”。
en: Anything touching on sex inevitably involves violence. To avoid harassment and harm, sex workers need to attach themselves to one or more 'big brothers'.

text: 平时有些需要打点的事情，由这些大哥出面解决。
en: For the usual matters that need smoothing over, these big brothers step in to resolve them.

text: 这些大哥被称为Babu，
en: These big brothers are called Babu,

text: 有些姑娘和Babu的关系是复杂的，即是交易对象，又是情侣关系。
en: Some girls have a complex relationship with their Babu — he is both a client and a romantic partner.

text: 而有些Babu则是把这些姑娘当做了吸血对象，逼他们去接更多的客。
en: Other Babus treat these girls as objects to bleed dry, forcing them to take more clients.

text: 把从姑娘们的敲骨吸髓得来的钱拿去供养自己的家庭。
en: They take the money squeezed from the girls' very bones to support their own families.

text: 当然这个故事也并非完全没有一点光
en: Of course, this story is not entirely without a glimmer of light.

text: 前面提到的Farida，靠自己的 努力买了房，半价出租给其他性工作者接客使用，帮助她们省下更多的钱，早日攒够钱赎身，离开这里。
en: The Farida mentioned earlier bought a house through her own efforts, and rents it out at half price to other sex workers for receiving clients, helping them save more money to buy their freedom sooner and leave.

text: Farida还有一间小诊所，有医生为其他性工作者提供免费医疗，如艾滋病，梅毒，乙肝等等。
en: Farida also has a small clinic where a doctor provides free medical care to other sex workers, for AIDS, syphilis, hepatitis B and so on.

text: 在红灯区，有许多人没有戴套的习惯。
en: In the red-light district, many people have no habit of wearing condoms.

text: 不带套价格是28人民币左右，而戴套价格只有11-17人民币。
en: Going without a condom costs around 28 RMB, while with a condom the price is only 11–17 RMB.

text: 在与医生的聊天中得知，梅毒和乙肝在红灯区是比较常见的，得艾滋病只有一位。
en: In conversation with the doctor, it was learned that syphilis and hepatitis B are fairly common in the red-light district, and only one person has contracted AIDS.

text: 但这一位依然还在接客，医生只能提醒她需要让客人带避孕套。
en: But this one is still receiving clients; the doctor can only remind her that she needs to have clients wear condoms.

text: 疾病和死亡是每天都会在红灯区上演发生的。
en: Disease and death play out in the red-light district every day.

text: 而死亡的性工作者尸体，会在腰间和脖子上绑上石头，然后扔到河中。
en: The bodies of deceased sex workers are tied with stones around the waist and neck, then thrown into the river.

text: 因为她们被排除主流之外的人，她们是不配入土为安的。
en: Because they are people excluded from the mainstream; they are unworthy of a proper burial.

text: 她们的归宿只有河流，也只有河流能带她们离开红灯区。
en: The river is their only resting place, and only the river can carry them away from the red-light district.

text: 而同样被束缚在这片红灯区的，还有这些性工作者的孩子们。
en: Also bound within this red-light district are the children of these sex workers.

text: 当这些性工作者或主动或被动的生下这些孩子后，小一点的。
en: After these sex workers give birth to these children, whether willingly or not, the younger ones

text: 在母亲接客时躲在床底下。
en: Hide under the bed while their mother receives clients.

text: 稍大一点就会去沿街拉客，大声喊着，这里有漂亮的姑娘。
en: Slightly older ones go out to solicit on the streets, shouting loudly: pretty girls here.

text: 在这样扭曲环境下长大的他们，会走入上一代人的循环
en: Having grown up in such a distorted environment, they will fall into the cycle of the previous generation.

text: 还记得我前面提到的成为合法性工作者的三个条件吗？
en: Do you still remember the three conditions for becoming a legal sex worker that I mentioned earlier?

text: 年满18岁，贫困，自愿。
en: Over eighteen, poverty, voluntary.

text: 在这里，只有贫困是不需要伪造的。
en: Here, only poverty needs no falsification.

text: 节目的最后，依然是Farida，她为了让女儿跳出这个罪孽的循环，把自己的女儿寄养在娘家。
en: At the end of the programme, it is still Farida. To let her daughter escape this cycle of sin, she placed her daughter in the care of her own family.

text: 她隐瞒了自己的工作，靠自己的工作去养育她，最终把女儿培养成了一名眼科医生，在考取医生证明的时候，登记人员需要登记父亲的信息。
en: She hid her work and raised her daughter through her own labour, ultimately bringing her up to become an ophthalmologist. When the daughter sat the exam for her medical licence, the registrar needed to record the father's information.

text: Farida质问道:
en: Farida asked indignantly:

text: 最后我想说
en: Finally, I want to say

text: 污泥中开出了鲜花固然值得称赞，但更重要的是让污泥不要来到这世间。
en: A flower blooming from the mud is certainly worthy of praise, but more important is to keep the mud from ever coming into this world.
